Surface.description:
One declared operator-facing web surface of a capability node.

Identity, kind and permissions are immutable manifest facts; readiness and
the volatile endpoint arrive in correlated health replies. ``proxied``
surfaces are declared so the manifest is complete, but their endpoints are
withheld from every projection until the proxy contract is qualified.
Surface.title: Surface

SurfaceReport.description:
Volatile readiness of one declared surface, reported with health.

A complete snapshot is expected: a declared surface absent from the reply
is not ready and any earlier endpoint is withdrawn.
SurfaceReport.title: SurfaceReport

OperationBounds.description: Limits for durable operations a node runs outside the invocation slot.

reservations.description: Replay-fence capacity. Reaching it refuses new starts rather than forgetting old ids, which would make them replayable.
reservations.title: Reservations

OperationBounds.title: OperationBounds

StewardExposure.description:
Trusted private manifest classification; never inferred from tool text.

``read`` exposures become direct steward tools; ``lifecycle`` and
``operation`` exposures become inert proposals that need an approval. A
declaration is not evidence of enforcement: the owner still validates the
manifest and the child still checks authority at dispatch.

provider_selection.description: Governed provider for lifecycle exposures; None only for read and operation exposures that select no provider.
provider_selection.title: Provider Selection

summary.description: Model-facing tool description; omitted means the descriptor's.
summary.title: Summary

Startup.description:
What a child reads from its inherited startup descriptor.

Private inherited descriptor contents, never command-line credentials. Part
of the authoring surface: a capability's child parses exactly this, with
``storage.read_startup``. The owner writes it canonically and refuses to
start a child whose record would exceed ``MAX_STARTUP_BYTES``.

stream_socket.description: Owner-provisioned media socket, unavailable to Fabric callers.
stream_socket.title: Stream Socket

credential_config.description: Provisioned backend configuration; private startup IPC only.
credential_config.title: Credential Config

serve_host.description: Protocol 3: the address the host lets this child serve on besides loopback, the node's Tailscale address. Absent when the node has none, and always at protocol 2. See ``serving``.
serve_host.title: Serve Host

Startup.title: Startup

ApprovedEffect.description: Exact signed effect bounds, optionally tied to a complete reviewed proposal.

proposal_digest.description: Complete immutable proposal digest for owner-reviewed approvals; omitted only by the legacy direct approval path.
proposal_digest.title: Proposal Digest

campaign_policy_digest.description: Complete reviewed campaign policy; absent for legacy proofs.
campaign_policy_digest.title: Campaign Policy Digest

ApprovedEffect.title: ApprovedEffect

OperationCall.description: One verb of the operation contract; the dispatcher checks authority.
OperationCall.title: OperationCall

OperationStatus.description: Observation envelope of one operation; opaque references, safe errors.

input.description: The recorded start input, so a caller can run the operation again or vary it. Carried by ``status`` when it fits beside the result (``MAX_INPUT_ECHO_BYTES``); listings omit it.
input.title: Input

OperationStatus.title: OperationStatus

OperationPlan.description: Immutable estimate a caller reviews before ``start``.

input.description: The input to start with: the caller's, completed with what the plan chose (a seed, for one) and carrying ``plan_digest``, so the reviewed plan is the one that starts. Absent when the operation chooses nothing beyond the caller's input.
input.title: Input

OperationPlan.title: OperationPlan

OperationStatus.description: Observation envelope of one operation; opaque references, safe errors.

input.description: The recorded start input, so a caller can run the operation again or vary it. Carried by ``status`` when it fits beside the result (``MAX_INPUT_ECHO_BYTES``); listings omit it.
input.title: Input

OperationStatus.title: OperationStatus

OperationPage.description:
One page of retained operations, newest first, compacted.

Results and backend references can each reach their bounds, so a listing
carries statuses without them (``status`` returns the full record) and at
most ``PAGE_SIZE`` entries; ``next_offset`` continues the listing.

outstanding.description: Interrupted rows: the backend may still hold their jobs.
outstanding.title: Outstanding

OperationPage.title: OperationPage

OperationLog.description: One offset-addressed slice of an operation's bounded log.
OperationLog.title: OperationLog

Health.description: Correlated challenge/response; readiness is not inferred from a PID.

surfaces.description: Complete readiness snapshot of the declared surfaces.
surfaces.title: Surfaces

Health.title: Health

Hello.description:
Authenticated startup identity and exact manifest agreement.

The child answers with the digest of the manifest it read from its startup
record rather than echoing the manifest back: the check is the same, and
the message stays small however much a capability declares.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest the child read from its startup record (manifest_digest); the owner compares it with its own.
manifest_sha256.title: Manifest Sha256

Hello.title: Hello

Invoke.description: One bounded unary invocation; execution time is a remaining local budget.
Invoke.title: Invoke

Result.description: Correlated success or bounded typed failure, with one terminal only.
Result.title: Result

Shutdown.description: Request graceful shutdown before the supervisor escalates.
Shutdown.title: Shutdown

StreamHello.description: Bind a fresh media connection to the installed child and admitted call.
StreamHello.title: StreamHello

StreamInvoke.description: Admit one duplex invocation on its separately authenticated media channel.
StreamInvoke.title: StreamInvoke

is not ready and any earlier endpoint is withdrawn.
SurfaceReport.title: SurfaceReport

BlobMedia.description: Opaque immutable blob reference; resolution remains Fabric-owned.
BlobMedia.title: BlobMedia

InlineMedia.description: Raw media plus format metadata; never encode the bytes as JSON.
InlineMedia.title: InlineMedia

StreamEnd.description: Child cleanup acknowledgment following exactly one output terminal.
StreamEnd.title: StreamEnd

StreamFrame.description: One sequenced input or output frame, aligned with Skulk's public contract.
StreamFrame.title: StreamFrame
